glossary.label: Invoice endpoints
glossary.description: The web address the billing screens call to work with invoices.

glossary.label: Invoice operations
glossary.description: The rules for drafting, editing, sending and cancelling an invoice.

glossary.label: Tax rules
glossary.description: Works out what tax a customer owes based on the country they are billed in.

glossary.label: Invoice
glossary.description: A bill sent to a customer: who owes it, how much, when it is due, and where it has got to.

glossary.label: Invoice records
glossary.description: Reads and writes invoices in the billing database.

glossary.label: Invoice announcements
glossary.description: Tells other systems when an invoice goes out, and hears back when it is paid.

glossary.label: Overdue sweep
glossary.description: The nightly check that flags invoices the customer has not paid in time.

glossary.label: New invoice details
glossary.description: What a billing user must supply to raise an invoice.

glossary.label: Invoice service
glossary.description: The Java backend that runs invoicing.

glossary.label: Invoice records
glossary.description: Every invoice the business has raised.

glossary.label: Draft an invoice
glossary.description: Raises a new invoice for a customer, with tax worked out.

glossary.label: Correct a draft
glossary.description: Changes a draft invoice before it reaches the customer.

glossary.label: Send to customer
glossary.description: Locks the amounts, records the send date, and emails the invoice.

glossary.label: Cancel an invoice
glossary.description: Withdraws an invoice raised by mistake.

glossary.label: Account check
glossary.description: Only the account an invoice belongs to may send or cancel it.

glossary.label: Work out the tax
glossary.description: The tax owed on an amount for the customer's country.

glossary.label: Explain the tax
glossary.description: How tax is handled for this customer, in plain English.

glossary.label: Flag late invoices
glossary.description: Marks unpaid invoices past their due date so collections can chase them.

glossary.label: Announce the send
glossary.description: Tells the rest of the business an invoice has gone out.

glossary.label: Record a payment
glossary.description: Marks the invoice paid once the payment service confirms the money.

glossary.label: List invoices
glossary.description: The invoices a billing user can act on today.

glossary.label: Open an invoice
glossary.description: Everything about one invoice.

glossary.label: Raise an invoice
glossary.description: Creates a new draft invoice for a customer.

glossary.label: Correct an invoice
glossary.description: Saves changes to a draft before it is sent.

glossary.label: Send an invoice
glossary.description: Sends the invoice to the customer and emails them the PDF.

glossary.label: Cancel an invoice
glossary.description: Withdraws an invoice that should never have been raised.

glossary.label: Invoice sent
glossary.description: Announced whenever an invoice goes out to a customer.

glossary.label: Payment received
glossary.description: Heard from the payments service when a customer pays.
